name: notification-center
title: NotificationCenter
description: Inbox of system + user notifications. Popover-anchored from a Bell icon in the Navbar (default) or a route at /inbox. Items group by recency (Today / Earlier / Last week). Unread items carry a leading dot in text.accent. Hosts read/unread toggle, mark-all-read, archive, and category filter chips. Distinct from Toast (transient) and Alert (in-flow).
